description:
Each crate-jmap-{calendars,chat,contacts,filenode,mail,sharing,tasks}-client/src/methods/<X>.rs returns `Result<_, jmap_base_client::ClientError>` from every public method.

Callers must add a separate dependency on jmap-base-client to spell the error type they receive. This is a leaky abstraction — the convention is that a high-level crate either re-exports its public error type or wraps it.

Fix: add `pub use jmap_base_client::ClientError;` to each of the 7 client crates' lib.rs. Trivial, mechanical, ~7 lines added.

This makes downstream usage:

```rust
use jmap_mail_client::ClientError;  // works
```

instead of:

```rust
use jmap_base_client::ClientError;  // requires extra dep
```
title: P2: 7 client crates' public API returns ClientError but none re-export it
